# US vs CHINA AI

> Independent comparison of frontier AI models from the United States and China, ranked by capability and cost efficiency.

Website: https://usvschina.ai/
Updated: 2026-11-10

## Pages

- [Current leaderboard](https://usvschina.ai/): Model rankings and national scores.
- [Historical archive](https://usvschina.ai/history.html): Dated snapshots recalculated under the current scoring algorithm.
- [Methodology](https://usvschina.ai/about.html): Scoring, evidence selection, pricing, and limitations.
- [Privacy](https://usvschina.ai/privacy.html)
- [Terms](https://usvschina.ai/terms.html)
- [Sitemap](https://usvschina.ai/sitemap.xml)

## Machine-readable data

- [Publication manifest](https://usvschina.ai/data/publication.json): Artifact hashes, scoring revision, and publication generation.
- [Site summary](https://usvschina.ai/data/site_summary.json): Current rankings, national totals, benchmark names, and archive index.
- [Current snapshot](https://usvschina.ai/current.json): Latest roster and benchmark results.
- [Historical snapshots](https://usvschina.ai/models.json): Retained historical rosters and recalculated scores.
- [Model catalog](https://usvschina.ai/data/model_catalog.json): Model profiles, dated prices, and benchmark evidence.
- [Scoring revision](https://usvschina.ai/data/scoring_revision.json): Version of the published scoring inputs.

## How are models ranked?

Unified Score ranges from 0 to 1000:
`Unified = 10 × (0.9 × norm(AvgIQ) + 0.1 × norm(Value))`

Avg IQ combines seventeen selected benchmarks using fixed allocations and a constant denominator. Missing results contribute zero. Each benchmark uses the highest verified score for the exact model across effort levels. Participation and benchmark coverage do not determine eligibility.

Value measures intelligence per dollar per million tokens using total input and output pricing. Models without usable pricing receive zero Value. Avg IQ and Value are cohort-normalized before blending into Unified. See the methodology page and the published scoring revision for the complete calculation.

## Which country leads?

National scores sum the Unified Scores of each country's models in the combined global Top 10. Use the current site summary for the answer and cite its snapshot timestamp; do not infer a current leader from this document.

## How fresh is the data?

Scraping is scheduled daily. A snapshot reaches production after its publication passes validation and is promoted through develop to main. The current snapshot timestamp is the observation date; a scrape completing does not itself mean production was updated. Historical timestamps and rosters are preserved when scores are recalculated.

## Sources and citation

Data is aggregated from llm-stats.com and verified public benchmark evidence. Consult the model catalog for individual evidence URLs and available dates.

Cite "US vs CHINA AI, https://usvschina.ai/" together with the snapshot timestamp and scoring revision from the publication. Rankings are comparative measurements, not endorsements. The site is independent of model providers and does not guarantee source completeness or accuracy.
